moves.name: Raptor Boost

moves.name: Falcon Dive
moves.notes: can grab ledge 5 frames after active end. if grabbed, hit is active frames 2-6 and hit animation takes a total of 79 frames

moves.name: Falcon Dive (Air)
moves.notes: can grab ledge 5 frames after active end. if grabbed, hit is active frames 2-6 and hit animation takes a total of 79 frames

moves.name: Facon Kick
moves.notes: strong hit frames 14-16, weaker hit frames 17-24, weakest hit frames 25-32

moves.name: Falcon Kick (Air)
moves.notes: can also do 11% damage. landing lag only occurs if ground hitbox is activated, which is also the weak hitbox
